# find_intersection

Nguồn: [manim.utils.space_ops.find_intersection](https://docs.manim.community/en/v0.22.1/reference/manim.utils.space_ops.html#manim.utils.space_ops.find_intersection)

find\_intersection(*p0s*, *v0s*, *p1s*, *v1s*, *threshold=1e-05*)
:   Return the intersection of a line passing through p0 in direction v0
    with one passing through p1 in direction v1 (or array of intersections
    from arrays of such points/directions).
    For 3d values, it returns the point on the ray p0 + v0 \* t closest to the
    ray p1 + v1 \* t

    Parameters:
    :   - **p0s** ([*Point3DLike\_Array*](https://docs.manim.community/en/v0.22.1/reference/manim.typing.html#manim.typing.Point3DLike_Array "manim.typing.Point3DLike_Array"))
        - **v0s** ([*Vector3DLike\_Array*](https://docs.manim.community/en/v0.22.1/reference/manim.typing.html#manim.typing.Vector3DLike_Array "manim.typing.Vector3DLike_Array"))
        - **p1s** ([*Point3DLike\_Array*](https://docs.manim.community/en/v0.22.1/reference/manim.typing.html#manim.typing.Point3DLike_Array "manim.typing.Point3DLike_Array"))
        - **v1s** ([*Vector3DLike\_Array*](https://docs.manim.community/en/v0.22.1/reference/manim.typing.html#manim.typing.Vector3DLike_Array "manim.typing.Vector3DLike_Array"))
        - **threshold** (*float*)

    Return type:
    :   list[TypeAliasForwardRef(‘~manim.typing.Point3D’)]
